name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.AUTORELEASE_PAT || github.token }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Update git submodules
        run: git submodule update --init --recursive

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --ignore-scripts

      - name: Display Node.js version
        run: node --version

      - name: Rescript Code Compile
        run: npm run re:build

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Test React Hooks Properties
        run: npm run test:hooks

name: Run Cypress Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

# Explicit least-privilege permissions
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Setup job — runs once, creates a shared merchant + connector profiles.
  # The parallel Cypress jobs download the credentials artifact and reuse
  # the same merchant account instead of each creating their own.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Testing

    env:
      HS_Server_Url: "https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      # Download the GPG-encrypted connector credentials from S3 and decrypt.
      - name: Download encrypted creds from S3 and decrypt
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.CONNECTOR_CREDS_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_REGION: ${{ secrets.CONNECTOR_CREDS_AWS_REGION }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONNECTOR_CREDS_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          CONNECTOR_AUTH_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.CONNECTOR_AUTH_PASSPHRASE }}
          CONNECTOR_CREDS_S3_BUCKET_URI: ${{ secrets.CONNECTOR_CREDS_S3_BUCKET_URI }}
          S3_SOURCE_FILE_NAME: "f53aa14d-e544-48f1-ac4e-0200f65e0cb6.json.gpg"
        run: |
          mkdir -p cypress-tests
          aws s3 cp "${CONNECTOR_CREDS_S3_BUCKET_URI}/${S3_SOURCE_FILE_NAME}" cypress-tests/creds.json.gpg
          gpg --quiet --batch --yes --decrypt \
              --passphrase="${CONNECTOR_AUTH_PASSPHRASE}" \
              --output cypress-tests/creds.json cypress-tests/creds.json.gpg
          rm cypress-tests/creds.json.gpg

      - name: Create merchant, profiles, and MCAs
        env:
          ADMIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CYPRESS_ADMIN_KEY }}
          HYPERSWITCH_API_URL: ${{ env.HS_Server_Url }}
          CONNECTOR_AUTH_FILE_PATH: "./cypress-tests/creds.json"
          CREDENTIALS_OUTPUT_PATH: "./cypress-tests/test-credentials.json"
        run: node cypress-tests/setup.js

      - name: Upload credentials artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-credentials
          path: cypress-tests/test-credentials.json
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Cypress test jobs — 5 parallel jobs sharing the same merchant account.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cypress:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: Testing
    needs: [setup]

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        category: [01-sdk-core, 02-cards, 03-bank-transfers, 04-alternative-payments, 05-external-3ds]

    env:
      HS_Server_Url: "https://sandbox.hyperswitch.io"
      HS_Client_Url: "http://localhost:9050"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Update git submodules
        run: git submodule update --init --recursive

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Download credentials artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-credentials
          path: cypress-tests/

      # Demo app only needs server/client URLs — Cypress injects keys via URL
      # params when isCypressTestMode=true, so no API credentials are needed here.
      - name: Create demo app .env file
        working-directory: ./Hyperswitch-React-Demo-App
        run: |
          touch .env
          echo "STATIC_DIR=./dist"                        >> .env
          echo "HYPERSWITCH_SERVER_URL=$HS_Server_Url"    >> .env
          echo "HYPERSWITCH_CLIENT_URL=$HS_Client_Url"     >> .env

      - name: Build and start local server
        run: |
          npm run re:build
          npm run start &
          echo "Hyperswitch Web started"
          cd Hyperswitch-React-Demo-App && npm run start &
          echo "Demo App started"

      - name: Run Cypress Tests (${{ matrix.category }})
        uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
        with:
          working-directory: ./cypress-tests
          spec: cypress/e2e/${{ matrix.category }}/**/*.cy.ts
          wait-on: http://localhost:9050/HyperLoader.js,http://localhost:9060
          wait-on-timeout: 120
        env:
          # Path to the pre-existing credentials file (downloaded from artifact).
          # cypress.config.js reads this and injects the keys into Cypress.env()
          # with PRESETUP_CREDENTIALS=true so e2e.ts skips the setup task.
          CREDENTIALS_OUTPUT_PATH: "./test-credentials.json"

          # Target environment (controls which API URL is used).
          TEST_ENV: sandbox

{
  "name": "cypress-tests",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Test cases in cypress",
  "main": "cypress.config.js",
  "scripts": {
    "format:cypress": "prettier --write \"cypress/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}\"",
    "lint": "./node_modules/.bin/tslint -c tslint.json -p cypress/**/*.ts -t stylish",
    "start":          "cypress open",
    "start:sandbox":  "TEST_ENV=sandbox cypress open",
    "start:integ":    "TEST_ENV=integ   cypress open",
    "start:local":    "TEST_ENV=local   cypress open",
    "test":           "cypress run",
    "test:sandbox":   "TEST_ENV=sandbox cypress run",
    "test:integ":     "TEST_ENV=integ   cypress run",
    "test:local":     "TEST_ENV=local   cypress run"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/juspay/hyperswitch-web/cypress-tests"
  },
  "author": "juspay/hyperswitch-web-sdk",
  "license": "ISC",
  "devDependencies": {
    "cypress": "^13.13.2",
    "cypress-iframe": "^1.0.1",
    "prettier": "^3.6.2",
    "typescript": "^5.5.4"
  }
}

Hyperswitch SDK Web Testing

## Quick Start Locally Steps to get started with Hyperswitch-web sdk testing locally: 1. Set up hyperswitch web following the [Docs](https://github.com/juspay/hyperswitch-web?tab=readme-ov-file#hyperswitch-unified-checkout). 2. Now that you have three terminals open, spin up a fourth terminal and do `cd cypress-tests && npm start` in the main repo terminal (hyperswitch-web) (Note: In case Cypress is running for the first time, and cypress script runs into an error, uninstall and re install cypress as a dev module inside the cypress-tests folder) 3. Cypress should open the window to test separate flows. 4. To run cypress in headless mode, put publishable key and secret key to be used for tests in `cypress.env.json` and then spin a terminal window and run `npm run test` 💡 Note: Incase you are setting cypress for the first time and run into a cypress error, try to uninstall and re-install cypress inside cypress-tests folder by running the following commands : ``` npm uninstall cypress npm install cypress --save-dev ``` ## Adding test cases: 1. Test cases to be written in [Typescript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) and type-safety to be used in all cases.
💡 Note: Try to avoid using `any` keyword as much as possible 2. In order to add test-ids to the components follow the following cases: 1. Create a new key in `hyperswitch-web/src/Utilities/TestUtils.res` 2. Add the key in: `dataTestId={TestUtils.paymentMethodListTestId}` as the property for the tag to be tested. 💡 Note: Either run the `re:build` command or keep the `re:start` command server running to generate the necessary js code

# Stage 1: Build the assets
FROM node:lts AS builder

# Set the build environment as an argument
ARG sdkEnv=sandbox
ARG sdkVersion=main
RUN if [ "$sdkVersion" != "main" ]; then gitBranch="v$sdkVersion"; else gitBranch="$sdkVersion"; fi && \
    git clone --branch ${gitBranch} https://github.com/juspay/hyperswitch-web --depth 1 /app

# Set the working directory to the cloned repository
WORKDIR /app

ENV ENV_BACKEND_URL=https://beta.hyperswitch.io/api
# Install dependencies and build the project
RUN npm_config_ignore_scripts=true npm install
RUN git submodule update --init --recursive
RUN npm run re:build
RUN npm run build:sandbox
# Stage 2: Serve the built assets
FROM nginx:alpine

# Set working directory and copy the built assets from the builder stage
WORKDIR /usr/share/nginx/html
ARG sdkVersion
ARG port=80 
ARG nginxPath=/usr/share/nginx/html/web/$sdkVersion
COPY --from=builder /app/dist/sandbox $nginxPath
WORKDIR $nginxPath/v1

# Add the embedded entrypoint script
COPY docker_helm_utils/change_urls.sh /docker-entrypoint.d/change_urls.sh
RUN chmod +x /docker-entrypoint.d/change_urls.sh

# Use the embedded entrypoint script and run Nginx
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
